As Universal Display (OLED) Stock Price Declined, Dsam Partners Llp Increased Position by $8.81 Million; As Facebook (FB) Stock Price Declined, Matthew 25 Management Increased Its Position
May 27, 2018 - By Louis Casey
Matthew 25 Management Corp increased its stake in Facebook Inc. (FB) by 4.86% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Matthew 25 Management Corp bought 1,750 shares as the company’s stock declined 14.10% with the market. The institutional investor held 37,750 shares of the technology company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $6.66M, up from 36,000 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Matthew 25 Management Corp who had been investing in Facebook Inc. for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $535.28B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.54% or $1.01 during the last trading session, reaching $184.92. About 10.97 million shares traded. Facebook, Inc. (NASDAQ:FB) has risen 8.48% since May 27, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 3.07% the S&P500.
Guy Shahar increased its stake in Universal Display Corp (OLED) by 26.48% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Dsam Partners Llp bought 51,232 shares as the company’s stock declined 40.02% with the market. The hedge fund run by Guy Shahar held 244,701 shares of the electrical products company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $42.25M, up from 193,469 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Dsam Partners Llp who had been investing in Universal Display Corp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $4.69B market cap company. The stock increased 1.79% or $1.75 during the last trading session, reaching $99.65. About 625,547 shares traded. Universal Display Corporation (NASDAQ:OLED) has risen 25.73% since May 27, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 14.18% the S&P500.
